heading.title: Timeline of events against trends of various climate drivers

series_names: Feb 7–10, 2020 East Coast Flood: AUD 0.97 bn
figures.source_line: Sources: Bureau of Meteorology (for IOD and ENSO data), British Antarctic Survey (for SAM data), Insurance Council of Australia (for loss numbers), Swiss Re Institute

blue SAM bars with cyan ENSO and dark-grey IOD lines drawn over the same panel
bars extend below the 0 gridline down past −4 on the left SAM axis
grey, green and yellow vertical tints span Jun 2019–Mar 2020, Jan 20 2020 and Feb 7–10 2020
horizontal rules at each left-axis tick, no vertical grid lines drawn
'Climate index: SAM / ENSO / IOD' and 'Events:' swatch block sit under the time axis
the 'Events:' swatch column sits to the right of 'Climate index:' in the same legend band
'Sources: Bureau of Meteorology (for IOD and ENSO data)...Swiss Re Institute' in small print below
'SAM' set vertically at the left axis, 'ENSO/IOD' set vertically at the right axis
the ENSO/IOD scale 2.5...−1.5 is drawn only on the right edge of the plot

superscript 6 and 7 in body text keyed to footnotes 'Severe weather in a changing climate' and 'Insurance Council of Australia.'

new_components.name: event_band_legend_with_date_and_loss
new_components.evidence: each event swatch carries a date line plus a loss figure: 'Jan 20, 2020 / ACT Hail: AUD 1.66 bn'
new_components.why_it_matters: 这些金额（2.3/1.66/0.97 bn）不在任何坐标轴上，只能从图例两行文字读出，表格必须把日期行和金额行一起作为行名，否则无法定位。

new_components.name: index_axis_without_unit
new_components.evidence: axis titles are index names 'SAM' and 'ENSO/IOD'; no unit phrase anywhere on the figure
new_components.why_it_matters: 数值是无量纲指数，读数时必须靠轴标题区分左右两套刻度（1 单位 vs 0.5 单位），否则同一个 0.3 会被指到错误的轴。

new_components.name: bar_and_line_share_time_axis_different_scales
new_components.evidence: SAM bars read against left 1-unit grid, ENSO/IOD lines against right 0.5-unit grid, same x positions
new_components.why_it_matters: 同一时间位置上有三个可读数，取值 0.3、−0.2 等必须先判定属于柱还是折线，行键需同时含系列名与月份。

a short positive SAM bar just above the zero line shortly after Jan 2020
an ENSO line point sitting on the right-axis 0.0 gridline around Jan 2020; several points share this level
the very short SAM bar dipping just below the zero line between Jan 2020 and May 2020
the positive SAM bar reaching about the left-axis 2 gridline near Sep 2019
the deepest negative SAM bar, between Sep 2019 and Jan 2020, ending between −4 and −5
an IOD line point below the right-axis 0.0 line; cannot be pinned to one month, the dark-grey line crosses this level repeatedly
an ENSO line point between the right-axis 0.0 and 0.5 gridlines; the cyan line sits at this level over many months
an IOD (or ENSO) line point just under the right-axis 0.0 gridline; the two lines overlap there, so the series is ambiguous
a second reading at the same level on the right axis — either the ENSO line at another month or a short positive SAM bar; not uniquely placeable

difficulty_notes: 取值精度是最硬的门槛：左轴每格 1 个单位（7 到 −5），右轴每格 0.5 个单位（2.5 到 −1.5），在 150 dpi 下一格约 30 px；而待评分值里有 0.3、0.0、−0.1、−0.2 这类接近零的小数，5% 容差分别只有 ±0.015、±0.005、±0.01，靠像素读数根本达不到；图上没有任何数值标签（values_printed = none）。其次是标签（step 3）：柱与折线共用同一时间轴，x 轴只标 5 个月份，一个 0.3 需要同时给出系列名（SAM/ENSO/IOD）和月份才能唯一定位，而这些月份在页面上并未逐一印出。

suggestions.what_to_add: dual_axis 与 right_side_y_axis 的组合（左右刻度间距不同：1 vs 0.5）
suggestions.where_to_change: 图表条件行中新增「双轴且两轴刻度步长不同」的样式字段，并在记录里为每个系列标注其所属轴
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 单轴 vs 双轴（同步长）vs 双轴（异步长）三档，比较取值被指到错误轴的比例

suggestions.what_to_add: 新提出的 event_band_legend_with_date_and_loss（阴影带作为图例系列并在图例中携带日期与金额）
suggestions.where_to_change: 图例样式字段增加「band 型图例项」，并允许图例项文本为两行（日期行 + 数值行）
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 事件带只有色块 vs 带日期 vs 带日期+金额，检验 markdown 导出能否保留轴外数值

suggestions.where_to_change: 时间轴刻度密度字段：每 N 个数据点标一个刻度
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 刻度=数据点 vs 每 4 点一刻度，测量行键缺失月份时的定位失败率

suggestions.what_to_add: P1 式的逐标记可达精度（本图无数值标签，柱与折线精度不同）
suggestions.where_to_change: 把 readable 从布尔门槛改为按标记类型给出容差：柱端点较易读，密集折线点较难
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 柱标记 vs 折线标记的可达容差分档，替代统一 5% 门槛

suggestions.what_to_add: mixed_marks（柱+两条折线共用一个面板）
suggestions.where_to_change: 面板生成器允许在同一面板混合 bar 与 line 系列，并各自绑定左/右轴
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 纯柱、纯线、柱线混合三档，比较系列归属判断错误率
